Kunal Bhatt is a senior embedded systems engineer at NexGen Systems, where he drives critical infrastructure for industrial automation. His work bridges hardware and software to deliver reliable, scalable solutions.  

Kunal’s expertise in C/C++ and Embedded Linux underpins much of NexGen’s core systems. He recently refactored a legacy sensor control module, reducing latency by 22% while improving fault tolerance. His deep understanding of firmware development allowed him to debug a complex power management issue in a distributed sensor network, cutting downtime by 15% during a high-stakes deployment.  

He excels at aligning hardware capabilities with software requirements. For a recent smart grid project, Kunal designed a custom RTOS framework that integrated MQTT/CoAP protocols, enabling real-time data aggregation across 500+ edge devices. His ability to balance performance constraints with system reliability ensures NexGen’s solutions meet stringent industrial standards.  

Kunal is a dependable collaborator with a keen eye for detail. He consistently identifies edge cases others overlook, and his calm, methodical approach to problem-solving makes him indispensable. I’d welcome the opportunity to discuss how his technical rigor and teamwork could benefit your team.
